findings.title: Inline appendTo function creates new reference each render
findings.problem: appendTo={() => document.body} allocates a new function object on every render of Hint. PrimeReact's Tooltip receives it and may compare appendTo by reference to decide whether to re-mount its portal container, triggering unnecessary portal operations on every parent re-render.
findings.impact: If PrimeReact uses reference equality when diffing appendTo, each parent re-render appends a new portal element to document.body without removing the previous one, accumulating orphaned DOM nodes across the SPA lifetime. Reachability is uncertain — PrimeReact's internal diffing of function-typed appendTo props could not be confirmed from static analysis alone.
findings.recommendation: Replace the inline arrow with a module-level constant (const appendToBody = () => document.body hoisted above the Hint component) or a useCallback(() => document.body, []) inside the component, so the reference is stable across re-renders.
